conclusions: STCO-FS skilfully predicts summer heatwave days at 9 of 12 Mediterranean sites (test AUC 0.78–0.90), beyond the warming trend.
Skill is highest in the central and eastern Mediterranean; Murcia (0.65) and Algeria (0.60) show little predictability, and Tunisia adds nothing beyond the trend.
Robust precursors are local and short-range: warm Tmax and a Z500 ridge over or next to the site, about 3–20 days ahead.

The CRO selects all eight Z500 clusters somewhere, but only five of them (four regional modes) show a significant anomaly before heatwaves in both train and test; the Alps–Balkans ridge does so at five sites (Monaco, Croatia, Albania, Greece, Algeria).
Dry soils are often selected 10–30 days ahead, but they are confirmed in 2011–2021 only at Turkey (3–14 d) and Tunisia (10–20 d), and only Turkey's signal survives detrending.
The KMeans clusters behave as varimax-rotated EOFs: regional modes of variability.

capability.label: Predicts
capability.text: Heatwave days in years it never saw: test AUC 0.78–0.90 at 9 of 12 sites, above a trend-only model.

capability.label: Detects
capability.text: Most observed heatwave days are flagged at 8 of 12 sites (Libya 80 of 96, Croatia 149 of 216), but with more than two false alarms per hit overall.

capability.label: Locates
capability.text: Where the precursors are: warm air over the site and a Z500 ridge over or next to it.

capability.label: Explains
capability.text: How far ahead: local Tmax and a Z500 ridge mostly 3–20 days before the heatwave; remote SST only marks warm summers.
